reset.title: Reset all connectors?
reset.message: This clears leads_to on every scene in the work — all timeline connections are removed. This can't be undone.

quick.title: Quick-connect in reading order?
quick.message: This chains the scenes on the timeline in reading order (.order), overwriting their leads_to — any existing branches/merges on those scenes are replaced. Scenes not on the timeline are untouched.

bench.hint: Fit = all nodes on screen (worst case; culling can’t help). Zoom in + pan to feel the realistic case. Watch the fps tone.

noAutowire.title: Why folders don't auto-wire
noAutowire.body: A folder shows its scenes but does *not* auto-connect them. The order in the Scene navigator can be mis-sorted, and auto-wiring would bake in a wrong sequence — so connections stay deliberate: draw them by hand, or use **Quick-connect** when the reading order is correct.

cellFlow.title: The cell flow
cellFlow.body: A read-only mirror of the Canvas branch graph, snapped to a VN-flowchart grid: the main sequence runs down the center spine, with branches flanking it. Edit the topology on the **Canvas** tab — this view is for reading the shape.

rows.Branch / merge badge: Marks where a route splits (branch) or converges (merge)

what.title: What Chart Config does
what.body: Author a **chart axis** — a linear route through the connected scenes that becomes a Gantt's X-axis. Create, pick, and rename axes in the sidebar; the preview on top is the real Gantt of the route you're lighting.

rows.Click a scene: Light it — auto-routes from the current tail (skill-tree style)
rows.Double-click a scene: Append the whole straight run up to the next fork
rows.Click an earlier lit scene: Truncate the path back to it

rows.Save (top-right): Every chart re-axes to this sequence
